eg14.lead.text: Tiro shay kasta, oo leh qashin, oo laga dhufto safka miiska factorka ee isku mid ah (miiska furan ee BimCraft isticmaalo). Shay kale dooro, ama midna ha dooran. Waxba looma diro meel kale.

eg915.lead.text: Ka soo dhoofi jadwal calaamadeed BimCraft (CSV) oo halkan soo geli: calaamad kasta oo gaar ah waxay noqonaysaa tiro nooc leh, soo geli mar kale wax baa cusboonaysiinaya. Waxaad sheegtaa tiirka magaca safka iyo tiirka lambarka hayaa.
